Your goal is to score as many points as possible and clear the playing field. Shoot balls at groups of three or more balls of the same color. The more balls you shoot down in one shot, the more points you get. The main task is to score as many points as possible and clear the entire field.
If you manage to knock down the balls, they will give twice as many points when they fall.
If your shot is accurate and the ball bounces off the edge, the points are multiplied by two for each bounce off the edge.
Do not miss, otherwise the playing field will fall down. If the balls reach the bottom of the field, the game is over.
Shoot without missing 5 times in a row to get Strikes and receive gifts!

At each level, you will be offered boosters that can help you in the game. Choose your boosters wisely and use them at the right moment to improve your chances of clearing the field and scoring more points.
When you use a bomb, it explodes all adjacent balls on the playing field, clearing the space and helping you score more points.
It helps you to aim better and shoot from the walls. Use your scope to improve the accuracy of your shots and improve your chances of making bubble combinations.
Good luck in the game! We hope that you will be able to clear the field, score the maximum number of points and achieve high results in the Ratings.
